Title: Yrel Hotfix Patch #1

Highlights: Bug fixes for Ragnaros Lava Wave on Towers of Doom and Thrall Feral Resilience tooltip armor value.
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
